goal: Stop dropping valid mineable transactions from the mempool solely because of their age
Reduce wasted network relay bandwidth caused by transaction rebroadcasts after expiry
agreement: Unaddressed objection: wallet test no longer checks parent resubmission before child (fametrano)
Concept approval: age does not indicate mineability and expiry encourages free relay (Eunovo, stickies-v)
Answered objection: removing expiry prevents operators from reverting if harmful (ajtowns)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because 92% of expired transactions are eventually mined, making age-based eviction counterproductive
Avoids rebroadcast bandwidth waste and removes per-entry indexing overhead on insertions and deletions
